name: echo_graph
description: Kural-to-kural edges: kurals that share rare words, with the words and their frequency, and kurals in the same chapter.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Kural id at one end; joins kurals.id.

fields.name: target
fields.description: Kural id at the other end.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: shared rare word, or same chapter.

fields.name: weight
fields.description: For shared rare words: the sum of inverse document frequencies of the shared words. Null for same chapter.

fields.name: shared_keys
fields.description: The shared words, as comparison keys.

fields.name: doc_freq
fields.description: For each shared word, how many kurals contain it.
